# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthians is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. These aren't passive suggestions—they're commands given to soldiers in enemy territory. The world around us is not neutral ground. It pressures, distracts, and tempts us to compromise at every turn. But strength in God's kingdom isn't about flexing muscles or never showing weakness. It's about resolve. It's about planting your feet on the truth of the gospel and refusing to be moved when culture shifts, when temptation whispers, or when life hits hard. Real strength shows up in the man who opens his Bible before he opens his phone, who leads his family in prayer even when he's exhausted, who confesses his failures instead of hiding them. That kind of strength is forged in daily discipline—not in the gym alone, but in the secret place with God. Today, you'll face a moment to stand or to fold. Choose to stand. The battle is real, but so is the One who fights with you.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and on each rep, say the word "stand." Let every rep remind you that you're training your body and your spirit to hold firm in the faith.
